title: Impact framing consult
summary: Clarify the change you want to influence and who benefits.

details.who: Researchers shaping a new project or early concept.
details.what: Work with a facilitator to define the public need, intended outcomes, and early partners.
details.outcomes: A concise impact statement and a first-pass pathway map.

title: Partner readiness check
summary: Assess roles, expectations, and collaboration readiness.

details.what: Review partner roles, decision-making, and communication plans.
details.outcomes: A short readiness checklist and recommended adjustments.

title: Grant impact narrative workshop
summary: Translate impact goals into funder-ready language.

details.who: Applicants preparing impact sections for grants.
details.what: Draft and refine impact narratives with peer feedback.
details.outcomes: A stronger narrative aligned to funder criteria.

title: Engagement plan clinic
summary: Design engagement activities that fit your timeline.

details.who: Projects with active partners or public-facing goals.
details.what: Build a schedule of touchpoints, events, and feedback loops.
details.outcomes: An engagement plan you can implement immediately.

title: Outcome tracking consult
summary: Choose practical indicators to document change.

details.who: Teams who need light-weight evaluation support.
details.what: Select indicators and tools that align with your goals.
details.outcomes: A simple outcome tracking plan and evidence checklist.

title: Impact documentation
summary: Collect evidence and short narratives of change.

details.who: Projects preparing reports or final outputs.
details.what: Gather outputs, testimonials, and outcome evidence.
details.outcomes: A concise impact brief ready for reporting.

title: Knowledge sharing strategy
summary: Select formats that reach the right audiences.

details.what: Choose formats, channels, and timing for outreach.
details.outcomes: A tailored dissemination plan with priorities.

title: Impact pathway mapping session
summary: Visualize how outputs connect to outcomes over time.

details.who: Researchers who want a clear, shared impact model.
details.what: Map outputs, short-term outcomes, and long-term goals.
details.outcomes: A pathway map that supports planning and communication.
